verdict_reason: Pure-unit test covers the two exports across happy path and unknown-party fallback; only a Minor weak-assertion note (toBeTruthy) — no Critical or Major issues.

todos.issue: Test 'maps each party obligation to its fulfilment id' asserts only toBeTruthy() on each mapping, so a party swapped with the wrong obligation id (or CONTACT mapped to a party's id) would still pass; concrete-value coverage lives only in obligation-party-map.test.js.
todos.fix: Assert obligationIdForParty(party) === expected id per party (e.g. import the obligations and check obligationIdForParty(consignor-party) === consignor.id, or use expect.toBe for each) so the file's own suite catches a mis-wiring rather than relying on the sibling map test.
